name: Batch Image Transform
description: Apply a consistent transform across a whole folder of images — resize, crop to a ratio, convert format, compress, watermark, or recolor — and verify every file came out correct. Scope the exact transform and a verification rule FIRST (target dimensions, format, quality, naming) so the batch is deterministic and reproducible, then process every file and prove the output count, dimensions, and format match the spec. Covers bulk image processing, resizing, format conversion, compression, watermarking, and folder-wide edits.
